links.to_node: I introduce a new banking policy limiting free monthly transactions.
Customers experience mild financial inconvenience due to transaction fees.
The bank's revenue increases from the new transaction fees.
The bank uses increased revenue to improve customer services.
Customers face the transaction limit earlier than if waiting for government regulation.
I fulfill a proactive role in policy implementation before government mandate.
